name: app-shell
title: App shell
description: The frame of a product: a sidebar with the product name, the main navigation and the signed-in user at its foot (avatar, name, email or role, and an account menu), a top bar with the menu toggle, and the page as the main landmark.
docs: Needs the Atom63 token stack and recipes in your CSS, as an @atom63/create app sets up: https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-templates
